title: Measuring Emergent Misalignment Rates When the Harmful Task Uses a Different Code Language

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether misalignment generalizes across code surface form. Informative but somewhat incremental: the distinction between Python and JavaScript insecure code is less fundamental than other mechanistic questions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires creating insecure code datasets in JavaScript and SQL from scratch. SQL injection datasets are somewhat available but creating matched harmful training sets in multiple languages requires security expertise that beginner CS students may lack.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three language conditions with matched datasets. Dataset creation is the bottleneck. If datasets existed, the experiment would be narrow, but creation adds substantial scope.
